title: Guapo: frases de la canción
source: Guapo worksheet (Después A and Oraciones revueltas)
summary: Write the sentences from the song. This is the translation exercise from the worksheet, in reverse.
instruction: Write it in Spanish (from the song)
explanation: The worksheet asks you to translate these lines from Guapo into English. Here you do it the other way: read the English and write the Spanish line from the song. This is harder, and that is the point.
Accents count. Use the accent keys under the box.

examples.en: There are women at my side.

items.prompt: I have green eyes and brown hair.
items.answer: Tengo ojos verdes y pelo castaño

items.prompt: There are women at my side.
There are no women at your side.
items.answer: No hay mujeres a tu lado

items.prompt: You are not good-looking; you are ugly.
items.answer: Tú no eres guapo; eres feo

items.prompt: You wear glasses and you have braces.
It is not necessary to be funny.
Sometimes I think that I am too good-looking.
items.answer: A veces pienso que soy demasiado guapo

items.prompt: I don't need to read to go to the movies with a woman.
items.answer: Yo no necesito leer para ir al cine con una mujer
alt: No necesito leer para ir al cine con una mujer

items.prompt: I am tall. I am thin.
Poor friend, you are not tall.
items.answer: Pobre amigo, tú no eres alto

items.prompt: He has green eyes and brown hair.
items.answer: Tiene ojos verdes y pelo castaño

items.prompt: The man is tall and ugly.
items.answer: El hombre es alto y feo

items.prompt: The woman is short and thin.
items.answer: La mujer es baja y delgada
